long_biography.plain_text:
At LUKOIL, Valery Sergeyevich Subbotin worked across the commercial side of the oil business, progressing through supply, sales and international trading responsibilities. He served as a management-board member and vice-president responsible for oil supplies and sales, roles connecting production with domestic and export markets.

Subbotin also chaired LITASCO, LUKOIL’s international trading company, and later held responsibility for strategic development. His education combined economics at Tyumen State University with further specialist study. The sequence of roles placed him at the intersection of corporate strategy, physical oil trading and the international distribution of one of Russia’s largest energy producers.
